description: Clients of realm fintechbankx and the audiences each may request. Source: platform contract (identity section and addendum 2026-10-08), repository bootstrap manifest, and call edges read from the service repos (mirrored in the mesh contract). ssoClients are confidential browser clients for staff tools (authorization code + PKCE). One confidential client-credentials client per service (client id = service id); its credential lives in Secrets Manager <env>/<serviceSlug>/oidc-client and reaches the realm import job as env FBX_OIDC_SECRET_<CLIENT_ID upper-cased, - to _>. audiences = service ids the client may call; each becomes an oidc-audience-mapper so tokens carry aud=<callee service id>.
